properties.areaDesc: Malibu Coast; Western Santa Monica Mountains Recreational Area; Eastern Santa Monica Mountains Recreational Area
properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 21 at 7:10AM PDT until October 22 at 4:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of southwest California, including the following
areas, Eastern Santa Monica Mountains Recreational Area, Malibu
Coast and Western Santa Monica Mountains Recreational Area.

* WHEN...From 4 PM PDT this afternoon through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.
Extensive street flooding and flooding of creeks and rivers are
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Rain rates between 0.50 and 1.00 inch per hour are possible,
heaviest tonight.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WATCH REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 4 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH THURSDAY AFTERNOON
